news.title: Continental Chemicals Limited Announces Resignation of Navneet Kumar as Chief Financial Officer, Effective January 14, 2026
news.body: Continental Chemicals Limited announced that Mr. Navneet Kumar has resigned from the position of Chief Financial Officer. Mr. Navneet Kumar submitted his resignation on December 13, 2025 due to personal reasons in view of his decision to pursue another career opportunity, with the resignation effective from January 14, 2026. The company submitted intimation in this regard to BSE on December 13, 2025.

news.title: Continental Chemicals Limited to Report Q3, 2026 Results on Jan 12, 2026
